subject: Film & Cinema
title: Japanese Cinema's Global Impact
description: Learn Japanese Cinema's Global Impact in one minute.

hook.text: In 1951, Akira Kurosawa's Rashomon won the Golden Lion and stunned the West.

buildup.text: Western audiences had barely seen Japanese cinema. Rashomon changed that overnight.

discovery.text: Kurosawa's films blended samurai action with deep philosophical questions about truth.

twist.text: George Lucas openly admitted Star Wars was inspired by Kurosawa's The Hidden Fortress.

climax.text: Japanese cinema proved that great storytelling transcends language and culture.

punchline.text: A samurai film fathered a space opera.

quiz.question: Which Kurosawa film inspired Star Wars?
